about: One human player attacks a site that a squad of AI enemies defends. A round ends when the player dies or every enemy is down.
goal: Make every round close. Whatever worked for the player last round should be harder in the next one.

enemies.about: The whole enemy squad. They share one behaviour.

formation.when: At the start of each round.

options.spread_out: One enemy on each way in.
options.watch_flank: One enemy stays back to watch the flank and the rest hold the site.

on_contact.when: The moment any enemy sees the player.

on_gunfire.when: When shots are heard in another part of the map.

options.send_one: The nearest enemy goes to help.

entered.about: The player walked into a named part of the map.

enemy_count.about: How many enemies start the round.

extra_cover.about: Extra cover the game can add.
